baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired partitives at words 2 and 6, the surging verb at word 4, and the doubled gathering at words 10-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: One agent first leaves a plurality in a boundary-eroding condition and later collects it: parts move into parts as a wave until a signal marks the reversal from dispersed turbulence to exhaustive assembly.

activation_trace.role: The state-result branch makes leaving an active placement into a condition, framing the surge as a governed interval rather than mere neglect.
Partitive segmentation supplies distinguishable fractions whose boundaries are then blurred by reciprocal incursion.
Interpenetrating wave-motion supplies the dynamic that disorders the parts and makes their local boundaries unstable.
Collection from dispersion supplies the terminal reversal: what moved without a common center is made one assembled multitude.
The completeness branch sharpens the cognate verb-noun close into assembly without remainder.

changed_reading.before: A chaotic crowd is followed by a gathering.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages two opposed operations on the same plurality: licensed boundary-loss among parts, then a signal-bounded conversion into complete collectability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive blowing at word 7, the instrument at word 9, and the immediate gathering at words 10-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Projected air activates an instrument, and the resulting signal changes the crowd's topology from many locally driven wave paths to one convergent event. The passive center is bracketed by first-person plural leaving and gathering, so the signal functions inside a larger controlled sequence.

activation_trace.role: Air sent into something supplies the physical initiating action and makes the transition signal pneumatic rather than merely verbal.
The horn branch identifies the receiving instrument and turns the blown air into a public coordination signal.
The image of parts catching up and force cohering supplies the response: formerly divergent movement is synchronized toward readiness.

changed_reading.before: The horn is a chronological marker before resurrection assembly.
changed_reading.after: The horn is also the ayah's phase-changing actuator: breath becomes signal, and signal re-coordinates a turbulent mass into convergence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same entities are named as parts in words 2 and 6 and as an exhaustively gathered whole in words 10-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Partitivity and totality coexist. Mutual penetration disrupts spacing, but the final collective can still consist of mixed, distinguishable members; completeness concerns inclusion, not conversion into one substance.

activation_trace.role: The part-whole branch preserves internal plurality even while one part presses into another.
A collective containing mixed groups supplies a whole whose members need not lose their distinctions.
Completeness makes the scope universal while leaving the mode of internal differentiation open.

changed_reading.before: Gathering makes the many an undifferentiated mass.
changed_reading.after: Gathering includes every part within one collective event without requiring fusion or erasure of participant identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate move from an interpenetrating crowd to a displayed destination turns gathering into preparation for confrontation. A covering relation is reversed: the locally obscuring surge is followed by an event made fully available to view.

activation_trace.role: Wave-like intermixture supplies the initially occluding mass in which one part disappears into another.
Collection supplies the ordered availability required for a shared encounter.
Bringing something out for inspection supplies the post-gathering act of disclosure and confrontation.
Covering supplies the opposed condition, making the sequence read as concealment answered by exposure.

structural_cues: 18:100 immediately follows the gathering and repeats the same-day temporal marker.
The display construction repeats its verbal idea with a cognate accusative, matching the emphatic verb-noun gathering close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: intermixture, complete collection, display, and covering. Reader arrow: collection converts occluded multiplicity into an inspectable encounter. Live alternative: only the destination is displayed, so individuation of the gathered people remains inferred rather than stated.

changed_reading.before: The gathering only relocates a chaotic population.
changed_reading.after: The gathering also prepares an exposure event: what had been visually and socially lost in mutual surge is collectively brought before a disclosed outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next description joins covered vision, lack of capacity, and failed hearing. Against that sensory blockage, the blown horn is not best modeled as an invitation whose efficacy depends on receptive listening; it is an event that gathers even those unable or unwilling to process an earlier address.

activation_trace.role: Projected air supplies the initiating event whose effect can exceed ordinary interpersonal speech.
The horn supplies a broadcast signal immediately coupled to gathering.
A visual covering supplies one blocked receptor and broadens the failure beyond mere acoustics.
Capacity or ability supplies the explicit constraint that ordinary reception could not overcome.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the failed response mode contrasted with unavoidable assembly.

structural_cues: The inability statement follows directly after the horn-and-gathering sequence.
The horn clause is passive while the gathering clause names the effective agent, foregrounding result over voluntary response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: horn-blowing, immediate gathering, sensory cover, incapacity, and failed responsive hearing. Reader arrow: the signal's efficacy bypasses normal reception. Live alternative: the incapacity may concern only remembrance in life, while the final horn could still be heard acoustically.

changed_reading.before: The horn summons hearers who then assemble.
changed_reading.after: The horn marks an efficacious summons whose gathering force does not wait on the audience's perceptual capacity, comprehension, or assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Physical density can mimic solidarity: parts press into parts and form one crowd. The following challenge to acquired protectors breaks that equivalence. Proximity, intermixture, and even collective presence do not create effective guardianship apart from the authority that gathers.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal parts supply the apparent peer network whose members are physically among one another.
Crowd interpenetration supplies maximal contact without demonstrating protection or control.
Acquiring a relation supplies the deliberate construction of supposed protective ties.
Otherness in place of the proper authority supplies the relational displacement under critique.
Standing over and managing an affair supplies the stronger function falsely projected onto nearby created agents.

structural_cues: 18:102 turns from the gathered plural to a question about relational reliance and prepared reception.
The focus alternates first-person plural agency with third-person crowd relations, separating governing action from peer contact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: reciprocal crowd contact followed by acquired alternate guardianship. Reader arrow: apparent social density is read as a failed proxy for effective protection. Live alternative: the surge may depict only physical disorder and have no social-reliance implication.

changed_reading.before: Surging into one another is only crowd compression.
changed_reading.after: The compression also exposes the impotence of peer density: being surrounded by others is not the same as being protected, governed, or rescued by them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wave is energetic but non-teleological: much displacement yields no arrival. Subsequent roots supply intentional striving that loses its aim, mistakes itself for good production, collapses, and receives no weight. Gathering then reads as the arrest and audit of motion that had confused activity with progress.

activation_trace.role: Turbulent wave-motion supplies high activity with no intrinsic destination or durable advance.
Collection supplies the arrest point at which dispersed trajectories become available for common assessment.
General diminution supplies the net result that contradicts the visible abundance of motion.
Missing the intended way supplies the failed direction of the otherwise purposeful activity.
Goal-directed movement supplies the intended progress that the loss-of-way branch negates.
Supposition supplies the mistaken self-reading that equates energetic production with good outcome.
Collapse and descent supply the failure of accumulated deeds to remain standing at evaluation.
Measured estimation supplies the audit standard under which busy movement can amount to nothing.

structural_cues: 18:103-105 progresses from announced loss, to misdirected striving and self-estimation, to collapsed works and absent weight.
The focus places complete gathering after unbounded motion, providing a natural transition from activity to reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: turbulent motion, purposeful striving, lost direction, mistaken appraisal, collapse, and measurement. Reader arrow: the crowd-wave is allowed to image effort without progress, with gathering as arrest for audit. Live alternative: the crowd motion may remain purely eschatological and independent of the later account of deeds.

changed_reading.before: The wave depicts only spatial chaos before assembly.
changed_reading.after: The wave can also diagnose kinetic delusion: intense activity that goes nowhere is finally stopped, collected, and exposed to a measure other than its own sense of momentum.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same prepared-reception root occurs for opposed destinations, while the favorable destination adds shelter, permanence, and no sought transfer. This makes the complete gathering a common threshold rather than a homogenizing endpoint: all are assembled, but reception and stability remain differentiated.

activation_trace.role: Partitivity preserves differentiated members before and within the universal event.
Completion supplies universal inclusion at the threshold without specifying one identical destination.
Prepared reception for an arriver supplies one terminal allocation after the common gathering.
The same reception branch supplies the contrasting allocation, showing that arrival structure can be shared while destination value differs.
A garden enclosed by growth supplies sheltered placement in contrast to the exposed turbulence of the focus.
Durable continuance supplies the stable endpoint opposed to wave-like displacement.
Change from one condition to another supplies the transfer explicitly no longer sought at the stable destination.

structural_cues: The same final-position reception term closes 18:102 and 18:107 for opposed groups.
18:108 negates desired transfer immediately after describing permanent residence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: universal collection, two prepared receptions, sheltered placement, permanence, and no desired transfer. Reader arrow: gathering is treated as a sorting threshold into differentiated stability. Live alternative: the actual sorting operation is not named in 18:99 and may occur outside its immediate mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Universal gathering is the final state and flattens the crowd into one outcome.
changed_reading.after: Universal gathering is a common threshold: it ends uncontrolled motion while preserving distinctions that become opposed receptions and, for one group, unchanging residence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus uses wave-motion for people yet declares their complete collection. The later sea can be converted into writing material and exhausted, while the words outrun it and any replenishment. The shared aquatic field therefore creates a scale contrast: creatures, however sea-like in multitude, are totalizable; divine expression is not.

activation_trace.role: Wave-motion gives the human multitude an oceanic material analogy of apparent unboundedness.
Complete inclusion supplies the claim that this seemingly oceanic multitude nevertheless has a bounded total.
Vast water supplies the finite material counterpart to the focus's human waves.
The ink-supply branch converts the sea from a medium of waves into consumable material for inscription.
Connected replenishment supplies the attempted extension that still fails to make the words exhaustible.
Meaning-bearing expressions supply the content whose extent exceeds every material reservoir.
Coming to an end supplies the asymmetry: sea-material terminates before the words do.

structural_cues: 18:109 repeats sea, word, and exhaustion terms and places additional supply at the close.
The focus emphatically completes the gathering, whereas 18:109 emphatically denies completion by material enumeration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: human wave-motion and complete gathering, then vast water, ink and replenishment, words, and exhaustion. Reader arrow: the repeated aquatic field is used for a finite-versus-inexhaustible scale comparison. Live alternative: the sea image in 18:109 may be independent rhetoric rather than a deliberate return to the crowd-wave.

changed_reading.before: The crowd's wave image simply communicates overwhelming number and disorder.
changed_reading.after: The crowd is overwhelming only from within creaturely scale: it can be completely gathered, while even an actual sea plus replacement supply cannot bound the divine words.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing declaration places singular deity, barred association, exhaustive negation of any partner, and each person's work beside the focus's gathered plurality. The collective is therefore unified by jurisdiction and encounter, not by sharing divinity or dissolving accountable agents into one being.

activation_trace.role: Partitive plurality supplies distinct creaturely members even at maximum crowd intermixture.
A collective of mixed groups supplies unity of assembly without identity of essence or role.
Exclusive divine oneness supplies the singular authority under which the many are gathered.
Association in divinity supplies the prohibited relation, blocking any inference from collective unity to shared divine authority.
Exhaustive negation supplies the no-exception boundary around prohibited partnership.
Intended action supplies retained personal agency within the universal gathering.

structural_cues: The pericope closes by moving from singular deity to individual expectation, work, worship, and barred association.
The focus's complete collective and the close's exclusive singularity use different mechanisms: inclusion of creatures versus uniqueness of authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: parts gathered as a mixed collective, one deity, prohibited association, no partner, and personal action. Reader arrow: the gathering's unity is assigned to jurisdiction rather than ontological fusion. Live alternative: 18:110 governs worship and may not directly explain the metaphysics of the earlier assembly.

changed_reading.before: Complete gathering risks sounding like the many are collapsed into one undifferentiated whole.
changed_reading.after: The many become one accountable assembly under the One; their collection neither shares the One's status nor erases each agent's work.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the local construction strongly selects the horn branch, while the shape branch belongs to another sense of the same mapped root. It remains anchored through the exact instrument word, projected breath, and reassembly sequence. Downstream prose should present re-formation only as a secondary root resonance, never as a replacement translation for the horn.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence of projected breath at word 7, the polysemous instrument/form root at word 9, and collection from dispersion at words 10-11.

activation_trace.role: Breath sent into a recipient supplies the animating material analogy.
The root's shape-and-figuration branch supplies a distant resonance of form being restored or made present.
Recollection of dispersed entities supplies the re-forming endpoint that makes the shape resonance perceptible.

changed_reading.before: Air is blown into a horn and the population is summoned.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that primary sense, the root network permits a contained echo in which breath, form, and reassembly jointly suggest re-formation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fetter and seizure branches are material analogies, not the ordinary senses demanded by the focus and context constructions. It remains validly anchored in the abrupt shift from unbounded crowd motion to externally effected collection, with a later taking-root supplying coercive grasp. Downstream prose should qualify this as a custodial undertone, not translate gathering as shackling or the later taking as arrest.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reversal from uncontrolled surging at word 4 to externally effected gathering at words 10-11.

activation_trace.role: Unbounded interpenetrating motion supplies what must be restrained for the scene to become a fixed assembly.
The root's binding implement branch supplies a material image of collection as imposed custody.
The seizure branch adds a context-triggered grasp image to the transition from free surge to held assembly.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is neutral colocation after disorder.
changed_reading.after: A contained material analogy lets gathering carry a custodial undertone: the previously unbounded multitude is not merely together but held within an imposed collective condition.

strongest_changes: The horn became an efficacious phase boundary rather than an optional audible invitation.
The crowd-wave became a model of energetic but misdirected striving arrested for audit.
Complete creaturely gathering contrasted with words that exhaust every sea-sized material supply.
Universal assembly preserved differentiated agents and receptions under singular divine authority.
summary.what_was_special: The late sea-ink sequence folded the focus's wave and complete-gathering roots into a finite-versus-inexhaustible contrast, while the immediate sensory blockage made the horn's result-producing force especially diagnostic.
remaining_uncertainties: The leaving verb can support deliberate state-setting, but the degree of causal determination versus permission is not fixed by the focus alone.
The form resonance and custodial binding are root-internal but sense-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The closing unity statement strongly contains fusion language, but its direct explanatory reach back to the mechanics of gathering remains inferential.
